new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.claim_supported: A second named China packaging-substrate buyer ran an international-open retender for a plasma cleaner in March 2026. Together with L01-114 it satisfies exact-category, independent, primary procurement demand and shows a reachable tender route.

new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.title: JCET proposed RMB 7.8 billion Shanghai Lingang high-end advanced-packaging factory
new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.authors_or_org: Jiangsu Changjiang Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. (JCET), Shanghai Stock Exchange announcement 2026-026
new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.claim_supported: Primary exchange filing commits RMB 7.8 billion to a high-end advanced-packaging factory in Shanghai Lingang; phase one includes production equipment and is planned for completion in the second half of 2028, with phase two adding equipment capacity. This is the official in-window customer-system trigger linked to plasma-cleaning equipment by two exact-category tenders and MIIT catalogue item 13.4.9.
new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.locator: Announcement 2026-026, project investment and construction-period sections; SSE query record confirms the canonical PDF path and disclosure date 2026-06-25.

new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.title: Plasmatreat products and services: inline Openair-Plasma process control
new_source_ledger_ready_metadata.claim_supported: Plasmatreat states that its inline plasma systems record process parameters, detect deviations, and can use threefold process monitoring; it also states treated results are not directly visible/testable inline. This is adverse incumbent evidence but preserves a narrower possible wedge in direct on-substrate surface-state verification and closed-loop treat-to-spec control.
